name: Substack
summary: Creator ownership, subscription economics, and the tension between growth and retention.
overview: Substack combines publishing, subscriptions, and a discovery network to help writers build businesses around their work. The report sees room for it to become a larger media platform, but the same audience ownership that attracts creators also makes it possible for successful writers to leave.

facts.label: Latest round cited
facts.note: Series C led by BOND and The Chernin Group

facts.label: Business model
facts.note: Share of creator subscription revenue; payment processing is separate

facts.note: The report describes a focus on private funding and growth
